title: Mastering the Confusion Matrix: True Positives, Negatives, and Errors

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 哈囉，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're talking about the confusion matrix and different accuracy ratios.
cues.zh: 今天要介紹混淆矩陣，以及各種準確率相關比率。

cues.en: So let's imagine that we are building a model that will predict based on images, x-ray images of lungs whether there is cancer or not in the lungs.
cues.zh: 想像我們要建立一個模型，根據肺部 X 光影像，預測肺部是否有癌症。

cues.en: So we're going to build a matrix here on the left, on the top we have the prediction of our model and it can be negative, no cancer or positive.
cues.zh: 在左邊建立矩陣，上方是模型的預測，可能為陰性，也就是沒有癌症，或陽性，

cues.en: Yeah, there is cancer.
cues.zh: 也就是有癌症。

cues.en: And then on the left we have the actual state of things.
cues.zh: 左側則是實際狀態，

cues.en: Is there, is it negative?
cues.zh: 究竟是陰性嗎？

cues.en: There is no cancer, in reality there is no cancer.
cues.zh: 沒有癌症，實際上沒有癌症，

cues.en: That person doesn't have cancer or positive, that person does have cancer.
cues.zh: 這個人沒有癌症；或者是陽性，這個人確實有癌症。

cues.en: So, and once we cross these rows and columns we'll have four different cells.
cues.zh: 將列和欄交叉後，就會得到四個不同格子。

cues.en: The top left one is called the true negative.
cues.zh: 左上角叫做真陰性。

cues.en: And by the way, before we go into this, the positioning of these cells depends on the source that you're looking at.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，開始前先說明，這些格子的位置會依你參考的來源而不同。

cues.en: Some places draw confusion matrix one way other places other way so, and I'll link to an article about this at the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 有些地方這樣畫混淆矩陣，有些地方用另一種方式；課程最後會附上一篇討論此事的文章連結。

cues.en: So back to our true negative.
cues.zh: 回到真陰性，

cues.en: So the cross between negative and negative is a true negative meaning the model predicted that there is no cancer and in reality that person doesn't have cancer.
cues.zh: 預測陰性與實際陰性的交集就是真陰性，表示模型預測沒有癌症，而實際上這個人也沒有癌症。

cues.en: So in this use case it's a great result for the person that's in question.
cues.zh: 在這個案例中，對當事人而言是很好的結果。

cues.en: Now the bottom right is called a true positive.
cues.zh: 右下角則叫做真陽性。

cues.en: The model predicted that this person has cancer and in reality they also have cancer.
cues.zh: 模型預測這個人有癌症，而實際上也確實有癌症。

cues.en: And while this is not a great result at all for the person in question in this model at least they know that they have cancer
cues.zh: 雖然這對當事人並不是好消息，但至少透過模型知道自己罹癌，

cues.en: and they can now address it with their doctor and potentially, hopefully get better, get treatment.
cues.zh: 可以和醫師討論處理，希望能接受治療並好轉。

cues.en: Now in the top right we have something that's called a false positive.
cues.zh: 右上角則是偽陽性。

cues.en: The model predicts that the person has cancer, but in reality they don't have cancer.
cues.zh: 模型預測有癌症，但實際上沒有。

cues.en: And this is called a type one error.
cues.zh: 這稱為第一類錯誤。

cues.en: And this is a problem because even though for the person in question, it's a relief that they don't have cancer imagine the emotional stress
cues.zh: 它會造成問題，因為雖然沒有癌症讓當事人鬆一口氣，但想想被模型告知罹癌時，他會承受多少情緒壓力，

cues.en: and suffering that they will go through when they're told by the model that they have cancer, even though they don't have to go through the stress and suffering
cues.zh: 以及痛苦。其實他根本不必承受這些壓力與痛苦，

cues.en: because they don't actually have any cancer.
cues.zh: 因為實際上並沒有癌症。

cues.en: So it would be much better if the model told them the correct answer made the correct prediction that they don't have cancer.
cues.zh: 如果模型給出正確答案，正確預測他沒有癌症，顯然會好得多。

cues.en: So it would be much better if the model gave them a true negative.
cues.zh: 也就是模型給他真陰性結果會更好。

cues.en: And then in the bottom left we have a false negative which is a type two error where the person actually does have cancer in reality, but the model says they don't.
cues.zh: 左下角則是偽陰性，也就是第二類錯誤：實際上這個人有癌症，但模型卻說沒有。

cues.en: And this is a very dangerous type of error because in this use case, the doctors won't even treat the person, won't even recommend any treatment plan
cues.zh: 這種錯誤非常危險，因為在此案例中，醫師甚至不會治療，也不會建議治療方案，

cues.en: because they'll think that the person doesn't have cancer and the cancer can grow and get worse.
cues.zh: 因為以為病人沒有癌症，癌症就可能持續增長、惡化。

cues.en: So both errors are not great and we want to avoid them.
cues.zh: 兩種錯誤都不好，我們都想避免。

cues.en: So the less errors our models make, the better.
cues.zh: 因此模型犯的錯越少越好。

cues.en: Now let's populate this matrix with actual figures.
cues.zh: 現在用實際數字填入矩陣。

cues.en: Let's say we have hundred patients, out of them our model made some predictions and we have 43 true negatives, 41 true positives, 12 type one errors or false positives
cues.zh: 假設有 100 位病人，模型進行預測後，有 43 個真陰性、41 個真陽性、12 個第一類錯誤，也就是偽陽性，

cues.en: and four type two errors or false negatives.
cues.zh: 以及 4 個第二類錯誤，也就是偽陰性。

cues.en: From this confusion matrix we can calculate the following rates or ratios.
cues.zh: 從混淆矩陣可以計算以下比率，

cues.en: We have the accuracy rate and the error rate.
cues.zh: 也就是準確率與錯誤率。

cues.en: The accuracy rate is the total number of correct predictions, meaning the true negatives plus the two positives divided by the total number of patients in this sample.
cues.zh: 準確率是正確預測總數，也就是真陰性加真陽性，除以樣本中的病人總數，

cues.en: So we have 84 divided by 100 or 84%.
cues.zh: 所以是 84 除以 100，也就是 84%。

cues.en: And the error rate is the total number of incorrect predictions, meaning the type one errors plus the type two errors.
cues.zh: 錯誤率則是錯誤預測總數，也就是第一類與第二類錯誤相加，

cues.en: We have 16 of those divided by the total sample size 100.
cues.zh: 共有 16 個，除以樣本總數 100，

cues.en: So we have 16% error rate here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡錯誤率為 16%。

cues.en: So those are two important rates to be able to calculate.
cues.zh: 這是兩個重要且需要會算的比率。

cues.en: So that's how the confusion matrix works.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣就是這樣運作。

cues.en: And as additional reading, I highly recommend checking out this article to have it handy for future use
cues.zh: 作為延伸閱讀，我非常推薦這篇文章，可以留著日後參考，

cues.en: where a person investigated the different forms of confusion matrix because different tools,
cues.zh: 作者研究了混淆矩陣的不同形式，因為不同工具，

cues.en: Python, or any other tool that you might be using can produce a different confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 例如 Python，或你使用的其他工具，可能產生不同格式的混淆矩陣。

cues.en: So it's better, it's good to read through this so you always know which confusion matrix you're dealing with in specific instance.
cues.zh: 所以最好閱讀一下，確保在特定情況下，總是知道面對的是哪種混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And in the tutorial, in our practical tours you'll be dealing with the one that we discussed today and the one that's pictured here on the bottom right.
cues.zh: 在我們的實作教學中，會使用今天介紹的這一種，也就是右下角圖中的形式。

cues.en: So I hope you enjoyed this tutorial.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這堂教學，

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見，

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習。
